title: BWU 3rd life
description:
this is a modpack for the BoyWithUke 3rd life minecraft event.
 NOTE: DOES NOT INCLUDE THE LIFE MECHANIC, ITS JUST TO HANDLE THE MULTIPLAYER
body: This is the 'United Boywithuke Minecraft Community' (UBWUMC) Life Series Modpack. It is required to play, and must be edited as little as possible. It includes mods such as Simple Voice chat, Essentials, (both required), and some other things so I can run this smoothly. Thanks! -UkeyDoodle
